issues.description: The Person model's firstName field has different visibility in the template and the solution. In the template Person.firstName is declared private with a public getter/setter, while in the solution it is declared public. This inconsistency can confuse students when they compare their template-based implementation to the provided solution (or when using the solution as reference) and may lead to inconsistent expectations about encapsulation and access patterns.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the visibility of the firstName field consistent across template and solution. Prefer restoring encapsulation by declaring firstName as private in the solution (and keep the public getter/setter), or alternatively change the template to match the intended public visibility and update the problem statement to clarify the intent. Restoring private visibility with getter/setter is recommended to match standard encapsulation practices.
